item.title: Charleston Battery add Ivorian midfielder Laurent Kissiedou on multi-year deal
item.description: The Charleston Battery are excited to announce the signing of midfielder Laurent Kissiedou to a multi-year contract on Saturday, pending league and federation approval. The Ivorian returns to the club where he recorded his professional debut in 2017.

item.title: 18th Annual Captain’s Comic Expo Scheduled for Feb. 21 & 22
item.description: Captain's Comic Expo (CCE), the two-day festival celebrating comic book culture, returns to Patriots Point in Mt. Pleasant on Feb. 21 and 22, 2026. The 18th annual event will be held within the Omar Shrine Temple at 176 Patriots Point Rd.

item.title: Local Organizations Announce Protest After Second Civilian Fatally Shot by ICE in Minneapolis
item.description: On Sunday, Jan. 25 at 5 p.m., community members and local organizations in the Lowcountry will gather for a protest in response to the fatal shooting of a civilian (Alex Pretti) Saturday morning by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents

item.title: Stingrays Win Second Straight in Overtime, Beat Everblades 2-1
item.description: In a battle between the top two teams in the South Division, Josh Wilkins buried the game-winning goal 59 seconds into overtime to lift the South Carolina Stingrays past the Florida Everblades, 2-1, on Saturday night at the North Charleston Coliseum

item.title: Mac Deford, Candidate for Congress, Condemns Killing of Alex Pretti
item.description: Mac Deford, candidate for Congress in South Carolina’s 1st Congressional District, issued the following statement Saturday after federal agents shot and killed Alex Pretti, a U.S. citizen, during a protest in Minneapolis.

item.title: How Online Dating Has Altered the World of Romantic Relationships Forever
item.description: Meeting someone used to require physical proximity. A bar, a church, a friend's party, a workplace. You needed to be in the same room as another person, and then you needed enough courage or luck to start a conversation. That model governed human courtship for most of recorded history. It no longer does.

item.title: South Carolina Drops Sunday Matchup to Florida, 6-3
item.description: In the final game of a three-game weekend, the South Carolina Stingrays fell to the Florida Everblades, 6-3, on Sunday afternoon at the North Charleston Coliseum in front of 5,201 fans.

item.title: Lip Sync For Lungs Live Battle Returns to Charleston Music Hall for 10th Anniversary
item.description: The American Lung Association in South Carolina will host the 10th annual Lip Sync For Lungs Live Battle on Tuesday, Feb. 24, 2026, at the Charleston Music Hall.

item.title: Wu-Tang Clan Legend Ghostface Killah to Perform at Building 64
item.description: Ghostface Killah, the legendary rapper and founding member of the Wu-Tang Clan, will perform at Building 64 in North Charleston on Saturday, May 2 at 7 p.m.
